why_invalid: Terminal lead returning to active work without a reopening event
preventing_control: Only T-28 (audited reopening to READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT) leaves CLOSED_LOST
CONVERTED is reachable only from QUALIFIED (T-19)
ASSIGNED is reachable only from READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT (T-12)
Every transition into a terminal status requires disposition_code
CONTACTED is reachable only from ASSIGNED (T-14) or NURTURING (T-18)
MERGED and INVALID have no outgoing transitions; work continues on the survivor
